mode: optical capability discovery from Problems-only PNGs, no solutions or model benchmark

verdictSemantics.existing: A physical apparatus family is exposed under some current strict validated scope; this does NOT mean all original parameters are sufficient to author a native scene.
verdictSemantics.partial: Some physical components exist but required source modes, geometry, composition or interpretation are absent.
verdictSemantics.not-exposed: Needed physical geometry or composition is not currently exposed by canonical Opticsim.
verdictSemantics.registered: A direct requested result kind is present in current unified dispatcher but may still require the original stated facts.
verdictSemantics.conditional: A related deterministic conditional analysis exists; native visualization/answer may remain unavailable.
verdictSemantics.unregistered: The original requested measurement or inverse relation is not a registered output; a successful ray trace cannot be labeled an answer.

caveats: These are assistant interpretations of images, not independently judged original answers; source questions can be ambiguous, diagrams need not be to scale.
Quantile sampling is a deliberate fixed 40 of 114 inventory, not a statistical claim about all problems or JEE overall.
Only /Problems/*.png were inspected. No /Solutions, textbook key, numerical answers, new model calls, or novel native geometries are produced.
Previously viewed examples may overlap the selection. We do not call this blind or unseen.
Requested-result support and apparatus-family support are separate; no missing source brightness/aperture/position is imputed.
Glass sphere/hemisphere is physically three-dimensional; a 2D cross-section must be labelled as such and cannot establish full 3D observational claims.

mirror-enclosure.name: Connected mirrors and reusable mirror enclosures
mirror-enclosure.feasibility: Existing finite Mirror; shared endpoints/corners and finite ray routes require careful validation

angular-inverse.name: Reusable inverse reflection/refraction constraints
angular-inverse.feasibility: Existing planar and mirror partial algebra; new queries must be proven, not substituted

extended-object.name: Extended object and shape-aware point sampling
extended-object.feasibility: Multiple sources exist; shape-identity and image mapping are not native measurements

general-motion.name: Nonlinear trajectories and moving optical positions
general-motion.feasibility: Current immutable moving-source player supports uniform translation only

apparent-image.name: Observer / apparent-depth and conditional image geometry
apparent-image.feasibility: Visual observer mode is not a calibrated image detector or exact 3D eye model

mixed-media.name: Cross-family refractive media plus mirrors/lenses
mixed-media.feasibility: Pinned engine has primitives; simultaneous boundaries, merging and medium membership need audited rules

glass-regions.name: Bounded polygons, curved caps and nontriangular glass
glass-regions.feasibility: Pinned native Glass supports straight and circular-arc paths; only triangle currently authored

beam-sources.name: Parallel and directional ray bundles through dielectrics
beam-sources.feasibility: Native emitters exist; numerical budgets and Fresnel branch completion require validation; user deferred

opaque-screen.name: Opaque stops, apertures, screens and visibility
opaque-screen.feasibility: Native absorbers exist; continuous blocked-visibility assertions need sampled-ray qualifications

graded-index.name: Position-dependent refractive index (GRIN) media
graded-index.feasibility: Native GRIN exists but expression safety, numerical integration and index positivity not validated

waveguide.name: Finite waveguides / guided multiple reflections
waveguide.feasibility: 2D polygon waveguide possible; 3D pipe capture-angle conclusions remain out of scope

ray-provenance.name: Bounded source-to-face/branch ray provenance
ray-provenance.feasibility: Current aggregate counters and first events cannot verify unique multi-bounce paths

prism-analytics.name: Reusable prism angular/deviation/minimum-deviation queries
prism-analytics.feasibility: Finite triangular prism tracer is present; inverse angle algebra not registered

material-lens.name: Physical/thick lenses and immersion-aware material properties
material-lens.feasibility: SphericalLens exists upstream; lensmaker/immersion depends on explicitly stated material and surface geometry

offaxis-lens.name: Decentered/tilted ideal-lens optical trains
offaxis-lens.feasibility: Native segment endpoints support transverse offsets; current canonical ideal lenses are y=0 and ABCD analysis is coaxial

instrument.name: Microscope, telescope and eye instrument models
instrument.feasibility: Lens trains run, but angular magnification, accommodation and observer conventions are not registered

lens-contact.name: Coincident lenses and equivalent focal power
lens-contact.feasibility: Current geometry rejects overlapping lens planes; model contact analytically without inventing finite spacing

multi-source-image.name: Image analysis for multiple sources and inverse lens placement
multi-source-image.feasibility: Multiple native sources supported, but source-specific ideal-image inference and shared-image inverse not

cases.systemSummary: Infer plane-mirror incidence from incoming/outgoing direction vectors
cases.caveat: Mirror normal is not directly stated; tracing alone does not answer the inverse.

cases.systemSummary: Two-mirror directional constraints with parallel input and exit
cases.caveat: Two finite mirrors can be traced if their actual positions and ray starting direction are stated.

cases.systemSummary: Object within an equilateral triangular plane-mirror enclosure
cases.caveat: Three mirrors meet at shared corners; native reflection counts are not unique image counts.

cases.systemSummary: Four-walled reflective box requiring a ray from A to B after four hits
cases.questionObservable: inverse source direction and path constraint
cases.caveat: Four mirrors fit count limits but their shared endpoints/finite target constraints do not.

cases.systemSummary: Two inclined plane mirrors with a specified outgoing parallel direction
cases.caveat: Finite ray tracing is possible with extra geometry, not a substitute for inverse angles.

cases.systemSummary: Concave-mirror image height for object distance expressed as 1.5 focal lengths
cases.caveat: Scale-free Gaussian image/magnification analysis exists; absolute native mirror size/f are unspecified.

cases.systemSummary: Inverse placement of object for fourfold concave-mirror magnification
cases.caveat: Forward curved-mirror image analysis exists, not the registered inverse magnitude branch query.

cases.systemSummary: Sinusoidally oscillating object before a concave mirror
cases.caveat: Motion player currently allows uniform translation; an oscillation law is not accepted.

cases.systemSummary: Quadrilateral extended object imaged in a concave mirror
cases.caveat: A single point-image prediction is not a shape transformation or native detected image.

cases.systemSummary: Moving point with axial and transverse velocity near a concave mirror
cases.caveat: Existing curved-mirror velocity calculation and constant-source motion cover the local model; source/emission/aperture not supplied for exact native scene.

cases.systemSummary: Near-normal viewing of a submerged object from air
cases.caveat: Surface is representable, but observer/image depth is not registered; exact water index is not specified.

cases.systemSummary: Curved mirror with a parallel glass slab between mirror and object
cases.questionObservable: image shift due to slab and mirror
cases.caveat: Curved mirror and planar dielectric cannot currently share a scene family.

cases.systemSummary: Plane-parallel glass plate backed by a plane mirror
cases.caveat: Planar interfaces and mirror can compose with fully specified finite geometry; exit separation measurement is missing.

cases.systemSummary: Parallel beam entering a glass hemisphere above a table
cases.caveat: Full CircleGlass is not a hemisphere; a screen spot is not equivalent to detector crossings.

cases.systemSummary: Continuous graded-index slab at grazing incidence
cases.questionObservable: curved ray trajectory and exit point
cases.caveat: Pinned GRIN primitive exists but safe authored function family and integrator checks are absent.

cases.systemSummary: Three planar media with grazing/critical incidence
cases.questionObservable: critical input angle and branch reachability
cases.caveat: Reduced planar angular calculations support this physical relation without inventing source position/brightness.

cases.systemSummary: Square glass cross-section at grazing input with emergence from neighboring face
cases.caveat: Triangle validator cannot represent a square; an equation of emergent angle needs labeled face evidence.

cases.systemSummary: Point source under water hidden by opaque floating disk
cases.caveat: Current refractive sources are single rays and there is no blocker or observer visibility measurement.

cases.systemSummary: Rays guided by cylindrical glass pipe using total internal reflection
cases.caveat: A 2D rectangular analog may be traced; exact 3D cylindrical pipe conclusions are not supported.

cases.systemSummary: Parallel rays crossing flat face and curved boundary of semicylindrical glass
cases.caveat: Native Glass supports arcs, but canonical circular dielectric is a full circle only.

cases.systemSummary: Equilateral prism with internal TIR and different exit face
cases.caveat: Native prism TIR and face events exist, but inverse index and prescribed multi-event path are unregistered.

cases.systemSummary: Isosceles prism with grazing emergence and minimum-deviation condition
cases.caveat: Needs conditional prism algebra, not invented triangle size or native source geometry.

cases.systemSummary: Prism given refracting angle, incidence, and net deviation
cases.caveat: Native finite prism can trace if the derived index and full geometry are known; reduced angular query missing.

cases.systemSummary: Prism emergence angle from incidence, prism angle and deviation
cases.caveat: One more reduced prism-angular query; no finite source/aperture needs to be guessed.

cases.systemSummary: Parallel beam partly reflected and transmitted through small-angle prism
cases.caveat: Pinned native Fresnel weak branches can truncate; do not conflate transmitted and reflected routes.

cases.systemSummary: Single convex refracting spherical boundary separating two media
cases.caveat: Full circular region is not a single infinite spherical interface; paraxial surface power unregistered.

cases.systemSummary: Sphere sliced into finite paperweight viewed from above a table
cases.questionObservable: apparent table distance through spherical cap
cases.caveat: Requires finite arc plus flat cut and observer/apparent-depth model; full circle is not equivalent.

cases.systemSummary: Silvered glass hemisphere with internal bubble
cases.questionObservable: multiple images from dielectric and reflective cap
cases.caveat: Nested/merged reflecting and refracting surfaces and multiple image branches need explicit semantics.

cases.systemSummary: Parallel beam through solid glass sphere near normal incidence
cases.caveat: Finite circular native tracer exists, but not parallel beam emission or automatic image inference.

cases.systemSummary: Internal air bubble in glass sphere viewed along radius
cases.caveat: Interior point geometry can be represented; bubble is not automatically an emitting point and observer imaging absent.

cases.systemSummary: Place converging lens so two object points have coincident images
cases.questionObservable: inverse lens position with two point sources
cases.caveat: Native multi-source lens scenes exist, but single-source image analysis and lens placement inverse only.

cases.systemSummary: Converging and diverging ideal lenses in optical contact
cases.caveat: Coincident lens planes are rejected; algebraic equivalent-lens law need not create overlapping native objects.

cases.systemSummary: Two coaxial converging lenses with specified separation
cases.caveat: Two-lens ABCD image analysis exists when a complete native authoring scene is supplied.

cases.systemSummary: Identical double-convex lenses from different glasses immersed in a liquid
cases.caveat: Needs explicit index-aware lensmaker model and material sign; geometry cancels for ratio but not a native scene.

cases.systemSummary: Two decentered coaxially separated lenses illuminated by parallel light
cases.caveat: IdealLens exists natively but authoring restricts all lens centers to y=0; no parallel-beam authoring.

cases.systemSummary: Variable eye-lens power for near/far accommodation
cases.caveat: Simplified eye geometry/retinal criterion and variable optical power are not authored.

cases.systemSummary: Corrective lens for finite myopic far point
cases.caveat: Diverging lenses can be drawn, but far-point accommodation/prescription calculation is absent.

cases.systemSummary: Swap microscope objective and eyepiece while preserving angular magnification
cases.caveat: Two-lens native tracing exists, but angular magnification and observer/tube definition missing.

cases.systemSummary: Microscope with final image at infinity
cases.caveat: Neither instrument angular magnification nor retinal observer/nearpoint conditions is an existing observation.

cases.systemSummary: Telescope refocused from distant to near object by moving eyepiece
cases.caveat: Lens-spacing edits exist; actual eyepiece motion, infinity beam, and angular metrics are not unified.
